messages:
maria: quick check: we need a short-term defense for duplicate token emission when resuming partial streaming requests after a hedged retry. Observed a customer double-charge when resume + hedges align.
devin: ugh. can you paste the repro? is it during resume token ack or at the billing cut? 
maria: repro: client sends stream, edge dies mid-response, client reconnects with resume_token. we sometimes have an inflight hedge to another region that then finishes and both responses get billed. crashing case: tokens were accounted on response-finalization.
ashok: idea: make billing event tied to canonical commit-point signalled by the gateway, not the worker finishing. gateway should dedupe based on resume_id + seqwindow.
sophie: also need visible event in traces so customers can see which RPC won. right now traces show two ends.
ingress-bot: deploy check: added experiment flag edge.billing_dedupe_by_resume_id on prod-canary.
maria: proposed contract: worker emits "candidate-commit" with commit-offset; gateway races workers, picks one, emits final "commit" to billing & metrics. other workers must drop billing hooks on receiving commit-id.
devin: little concerned about latency: that adds a coordination roundtrip to commit path. can we piggyback on last chunk/trailer? if trailer contains commit-id, gateway can act without extra RTT.
maria: yeah trailer approach seems ok: trailer {commit-id, final-offset, checksum}. gateway race logic: first commit-id wins, others suppressed. Also need TTL on resume tokens to prevent stale replays.
nashok: storage: small in-memory LRU mapping (resume_id -> commit-id) with 24h TTL; shard by tenant to avoid cross-tenant leaks. this maps to dedupe table used by billing pipeline.
sophie: SLO note: if gateway waits for commit-id from worker that might never arrive (worker crash), fallback must be a timeout that chooses the earliest successfully-completed worker and logs a partial-commit. That choice must be reversible for refunds.
maria: refunds are painful. instead, make gateway choose optimistic-commit if trailer not seen within X ms, but mark billing event as 'provisional' and start async reconciliation pipeline to reconcile once commit later arrives.
devin: how do we ensure idempotency if resume_token reused? need resume_seq + nonce. resume_id = sha256(tenant + nonce + creation_ts).
maria: agreed. also update client SDK: resume handshake includes resume_nonce and last_recv_seq. server should reject resume if nonce mismatch.
ingress-bot: note: rolling out edge.billing_dedupe_by_resume_id flag to 10% of agents.
nashok: followups: write RFC for commit-trailer schema, add LRU dedupe table in gateway, billing pipeline hook for provisional->final transitions.
sophie: I'll add observability tasks: traces, billing flags, alerts when provisional->final rate > 1%.
maria: thanks. Anyone want to take the RFC? devin for gateway bits + ashok for infra + sophie for observability. I'll draft the doc and ping for review.
devin: ack.
nashok: ack.
sophie: ack. :thumbsup:
